name: SLAI-T-Rex-Pro
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro (config.json max_position_embeddings 1048576). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: MLA variant with compressed KV, sliding_window 128, sparse indexer index_topk 1024; kv_lora_rank absent from config
notes: ADDED 2026-11-08. A finetune of deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro, not a new base model: architecture and parameter count are inherited unchanged (config.json differs only by the base's quantization_config key), 1598.84B total with 49B active. Storage does differ: the base ships precision-reduced expert weights (I8/F8_E4M3, 865 GB on the Hub), while this derivative re-uploads all 1598.83B parameters as BF16 (3.20 TB, 73 shards) — budget disk accordingly. Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-08-10, card cites arXiv 2607.20145.
